condition: Calling dayjs().localeData().meridiem() throws "meridiem is not a function" because the object that localeData returns has no meridiem method (at least with the default locale).
workaround: Don't call localeData().meridiem(). Format with the 'A' or 'a' token instead (e.g. dayjs().format('A')), or check that dayjs.Ls[locale].meridiem exists before calling it.
